title: What a Wash and Scalp Massage Adds to Your Cut
hero_alt: A man with eyes closed having his hair washed at a salon basin
card_text: A clean start for the haircut and a few slow minutes in the chair. What the wash and scalp massage add-on is, and how to book it.
lede: A wash and scalp massage gives your haircut a clean starting point and gives you a few unhurried minutes in the chair. Product, sweat and dust come out, your hair falls the way it naturally grows, and the massage is simply a good part of the visit. At my shop it's a {{addon:wash-scalp-massage}} add-on to any haircut, and it's already built into the Luxury Grooming Experience.
Here's what it actually does, what I won't claim about it, and how to add it on Booksy.

seo.title: What a Wash and Scalp Massage Adds | Carlsbad, NM
seo.description: What a wash and scalp massage adds to a haircut at Divinely Faded in Carlsbad, NM: a clean start for the cut, a slower visit, and how to book it.

blocks.heading: Wash, then hands.
blocks.lead: A small add-on with a big presence.
paragraphs: The wash and scalp massage is listed on my Booksy menu as an add-on, so you can put it on top of the Essential Haircut or the Signature Cut when you book. It costs {{addon:wash-scalp-massage}}.
Your hair gets washed, and your scalp gets worked over by hand instead of just rinsed. It's part of the appointment, not a separate visit.

In the Luxury Grooming Experience, it comes standard. That service also includes facial steam, two hot towels and a fragrance finish, so the wash fits into a longer stretch of the visit spent leaning back.

blocks.eyebrow: 02 / WHAT IT ADDS TO THE CUT
blocks.heading: A clean slate.
blocks.lead: The haircut starts from your real hair.

subsections.heading: Product out
paragraphs: Gel, pomade or spray from this morning holds hair in a shape that isn't its own. Washed out, the hair shows where it grows and how it falls.

subsections.heading: The day out
paragraphs: Sweat, dust and a hat band all leave their mark, especially after a workday outside. A wash clears it all out.

subsections.heading: A fresh finish
paragraphs: You leave with hair that was cut clean and styled clean, instead of a new shape sitting on yesterday's product.

blocks.heading: What I won't promise.
paragraphs: Read about scalp massage online and you'll find claims about hair growth, circulation and stress. I'm a barber, not a doctor, so I'm not going to sell you on any of that.

What I can tell you is what happens in my chair: your hair gets clean, your scalp gets real attention, and the appointment slows down for a few minutes. If that sounds good, it's worth the add-on. If you just want a fast cut, skip it.
If you have a scalp condition or any concern about your skin, that's a question for a doctor, not for a haircut appointment.

items.title: Essential Haircut + wash
items.body: The precision cut, a straight razor neck cleanup and a finished style, with the wash and scalp massage added on.

items.title: Signature Cut + wash
items.body: The cut with a beard trim or line-up, a hot towel and razor detailing, plus the wash and scalp massage.

items.title: Luxury Grooming Experience
items.body: The wash and scalp massage is already included, along with a consultation, a beard sculpt, facial steam, hot towels, waxing, a basic design and a fragrance finish.

blocks.heading: Worth it when.
blocks.lead: Skip it on a quick lunch-break cut.
bullets: You wear a lot of product. Heavy gel or pomade hides how your hair really sits.
You're coming straight from work outside, with a hat band, dust or sweat in your hair.
It's before something that matters, like a wedding, an interview or photos, and you want to leave fully finished.
You've got a little extra time and want the visit to feel less like an errand.
paragraphs: It's optional, and the haircut stands on its own without it. Add it when one of these fits your visit.

items.q: How much is a wash and scalp massage?
items.a: It's a {{addon:wash-scalp-massage}} add-on to a haircut, and it's included in the Luxury Grooming Experience.

items.q: What are the benefits of a scalp massage at the barber?
items.a: Your hair is washed clean before the cut, the cut starts from how your hair really falls, and you get a few slow minutes in the chair. I don't make medical claims about it.

items.q: Can I add it to a Signature Cut?
items.a: Yes. Pick the wash and scalp massage as an add-on when you book the Signature Cut on Booksy, the same way you would with the Essential.

items.q: Where do I find the other add-ons?
items.a: Every service and add-on, with its price, is listed on the services page and on Booksy.
